newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends stronger, retains edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends stronger, retains edge.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka retained its early gains and closed firmer at 42.8400/8450 to the U.S. dollar in interbank trading on Saturday, dealers said.

The local unit was quoted at 42.8420/8460 per dollar in early trade and gained further due to thin buying interest in the greenback. Dealers said a slight uptrend in call rates following last week's auction of central bank bills had further helped the taka. Call money was traded at 7.5 to 8.5 percent, slightly up from the previous 7.5-8.0 percent, dealers said.
